entries.17f67c23168e94c7: This reportable segment builds and maintains thermal, nuclear, hydro, cogeneration, solar and biomass power generation facilities, and designs and builds substation, general electrical, information and communications, and air-conditioning installation works. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥77,297 million. The main part of power-related facility construction work is ordered from the Tokyo Electric Power Group, which includes Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Inc., an other affiliate.
entries.3c137645910d4cb9: This division handles construction and maintenance of nuclear power generation facilities, safety work toward restarts, and decommissioning-related work at the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station.
entries.4b62defeeccc359d: A construction company whose main business is design and construction of electric power facility work such as power generation and substation equipment, and which also operates a power generation business and a real estate business.
entries.4f265a86e3a6e97e: This division handles facility construction for power supply infrastructure, such as thermal power generation facilities and substation facilities. It is the largest division by revenue.
entries.6a462516276993f6: This division handles construction of power generation facilities related to renewable energy, such as solar, storage batteries, biomass and hydro. Orders are growing as capital investment in decarbonization-related fields advances.
entries.acd96836bb990903: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments and includes power generation, real estate, leasing and rental, insurance agency, manufacturing and sales, and wholesale businesses. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,110 million. In Japan, it sells electricity generated from solar and biomass power, and a subsidiary in Thailand manufactures and sells power generation machinery and equipment.
